info.title: ZAS Wrapper Backend
info.description: FHIR gateway and orchestrator backend for the ZAS Telegeneeskunde POC.

get.description:
The caller's selectable roles on this surface (REQ-NON-3) — drives
the role picker and the user-menu switcher. Single-role users get a
one-element list.

post.description:
Bind (or re-bind) the session to one of the caller's role rows.

Works on an unbound fresh login AND as a mid-session role switch —
no re-authentication (REQ-NON-3 "log in once, choose role"). Every
switch is audit-logged with the previous and new role.

AppointmentParticipantInlineSummary.title: AppointmentParticipantInlineSummary
AppointmentParticipantInlineSummary.description:
Inline projection of one `appointment_participants` row.

Used inside `AppointmentPayload.participants` on the `TaskItem` envelope.
`user_display_name` is resolved via the same users projection used elsewhere
in the codebase (e.g. care-team participant reads).

AppointmentPayload.title: AppointmentPayload
AppointmentPayload.description:
Discriminated payload for `source = "appointment"`.

Carries the source row's data needed by the frontend without forcing
a follow-up `/appointments` fetch (which is also unavailable v1 — the
appointment domain ships without HTTP routes).

AssignedUserIdsUpdate.title: AssignedUserIdsUpdate
AssignedUserIdsUpdate.description:
Replace-set semantics. An empty list clears explicit assignment —
the carepath falls back to specialism-wide access (REQ-NON-12).

AtEnrollmentPickedDatePolicy.title: AtEnrollmentPickedDatePolicy
AtEnrollmentPickedDatePolicy.description: Schedule is the date supplied at enrollment as a deferred field.

CareTeamCreate.title: CareTeamCreate
CareTeamCreate.description:
`POST /patients/{patient_id}/care-teams` payload.

`participants` is part of the create payload so a team can be born
with a primary practitioner in a single transaction. Adding or
changing participants later goes through the participant endpoints.

CareTeamUpdate.title: CareTeamUpdate
CareTeamUpdate.description:
`PATCH /care-teams/{id}` payload — team-level metadata only.

Participant changes are out of scope here; use the participant
endpoints. Setting `status = inactive` or `period_end` closes the
team but does not auto-unassign participants — the service handles
that side-effect inside the same transaction.

DeferredFieldValueIn.title: DeferredFieldValueIn
DeferredFieldValueIn.description: One `(block_template_id, attr, value_json)` triple at enrollment time.

DeferredFieldValuePatch.title: DeferredFieldValuePatch
DeferredFieldValuePatch.description:
Body for `PATCH /enrollments/{id}/deferred-values/{attr}`.

Late-supply value for a `DeferredFieldSpec` whose value wasn't
available at enrollment creation. The engine re-evaluates
eligibility once the value lands.

DerivedEdge.title: DerivedEdge
DerivedEdge.description:
One canvas connector derived from a target block's `input_logic` rule.

`source_block_id` identifies the producer; for predicates that do
not name a block (`wait_after` — anchored on a marker, not a
block), `source_block_id` is `None` and the canvas renders the
edge as marker-anchored instead.

DueWithinPolicy.title: DueWithinPolicy
DueWithinPolicy.description: Block must complete within an ISO 8601 window of its eligibility.

EventArgs.title: EventArgs
EventArgs.description:
In-execution event: the referenced block fired a typed event.

`event_type` must be declared in the referenced block kind's
class-level `EVENTS` tuple (enforced at publish time — no kind is
silently usable as an event source). True once the event has been
recorded for the referenced execution; the receive endpoint +
event store land in the "pathway-nested-runtime" PR
(pathway-completion § B3.3/B3.4) — until then this predicate
evaluates to `False` at runtime.

FieldChange.title: FieldChange
FieldChange.description: One column's before/after. Named fields beat a positional `[old, new]`.

FixedDurationPolicy.title: FixedDurationPolicy
FixedDurationPolicy.description: Block has a fixed ISO 8601 duration.

HasDataArgs.title: HasDataArgs
HasDataArgs.description: A produced field on `block` is non-null at evaluation time.

IfDoneArgs.title: IfDoneArgs
IfDoneArgs.description: Predecessor block has completed (with optional `delay_iso` wait).

IfNotDoneWithinArgs.title: IfNotDoneWithinArgs
IfNotDoneWithinArgs.description:
SLA / timeout: the referenced block is STILL not done after a window.

True when the referenced block's execution is NOT in a terminal
state (`completed` / `skipped`) AND `now >= sla_anchor + offset_iso`.
The anchor is the referenced block's eligibility moment
(`scheduled_at` until a dedicated `eligible_at` runtime column
lands). `offset_iso` is an ISO 8601 duration (`"P14D"`, `"PT4H"`)
— one duration grammar across the model, matching `TimingPolicy`.

InputLogic.title: InputLogic
InputLogic.description:
Aggregate of rules attached to a `BaseBlock`.

`aggregator` defines the combinator: `all_of` (default — every rule
must hold) or `any_of` (at least one). `n_of_m` is an optional
voting threshold for `any_of`-style gates; when set, the rule list
must satisfy at least `n` of `m` clauses.

InputLogicRule.title: InputLogicRule
InputLogicRule.description:
One typed eligibility rule referenced from a downstream block.

`node` is the producer block reference (uuid string) for
visualization / canvas wiring; the predicate's typed `args` model
carries the same id and any predicate-specific fields. Carrying
`node` at the rule level keeps canvas dispatch O(1) without
walking into the args union.

ItemCategory.title: ItemCategory
ItemCategory.description: Shieldable item categories inside patient-scoped payloads.

LusciiAlertThreshold.title: LusciiAlertThreshold
LusciiAlertThreshold.description: A clinician-facing alert threshold defined by Luscii. Read-only here.

LusciiCategoricalPoint.title: LusciiCategoricalPoint
LusciiCategoricalPoint.description: A single measurement point projected from a multiple-choice item.

LusciiFreeTextPoint.title: LusciiFreeTextPoint
LusciiFreeTextPoint.description: A single measurement point projected from a free-text answer.

LusciiInstrument.title: LusciiInstrument
LusciiInstrument.description: A measurement / questionnaire instrument inside the program.

LusciiLayoutEdge.title: LusciiLayoutEdge
LusciiLayoutEdge.description: A directed connector between two layout nodes.

LusciiLayoutLane.title: LusciiLayoutLane
LusciiLayoutLane.description: A horizontal lane row inside the program's mini-canvas.

timing_label.title: Timing Label
timing_label.description: Short human label like 'D0' / 'W1-12 · 1×/dag'. Shown next to the node in the large block rendering.

LusciiLayoutNode.title: LusciiLayoutNode
LusciiLayoutNode.description:
A node inside the program's mini-canvas. Coordinate model mirrors
`PathwayBlock`: cell = (phase_id, lane_id), intra-cell = (x, y).

LusciiLayoutPhase.title: LusciiLayoutPhase
LusciiLayoutPhase.description: A horizontal phase column inside the program's mini-canvas.

LusciiLinkResult.title: LusciiLinkResult
LusciiLinkResult.description: Echo of the linked Luscii patient for eyeball verification in the UI.

LusciiMeasurementSeries.title: LusciiMeasurementSeries
LusciiMeasurementSeries.description:
A time-projected series of one instrument-item across the window.

`unit` is present only when `archetype` is `numeric` or `ordinal`;
categorical / free_text / unknown series carry no unit. Points are
sorted ascending by `observed_at` at projection time and the list is
never empty (series with zero points are not emitted).

LusciiMeasurementValueView.title: LusciiMeasurementValueView
LusciiMeasurementValueView.description:
One decoded `measurement.details` item. `label`/`unit` come from the
Luscii item localisation (nl preferred); `response_texts` resolve the
multiple-choice `response_ids`. Unknown items keep `label=None` with the
raw `value`.

`item_id`/`instrument_id` are passed through from the Luscii source row;
they let clients group values across measurements into a time-series.
`archetype` is set by the pure `classify_archetype` classifier — never
`null`, defaults to `"unknown"` when classification fails.

LusciiNumericPoint.title: LusciiNumericPoint
LusciiNumericPoint.description: A single measurement point projected as a numeric value.

LusciiOrdinalPoint.title: LusciiOrdinalPoint
LusciiOrdinalPoint.description: A single measurement point projected as an ordinal (allowlisted unit).

id.title: Id
id.description: Luscii's program id. Mirrors the `luscii_program.id` PK and `pathway_block.config.program_id`.

ce_class.title: Ce Class
ce_class.description: Luscii Vitals' MDR Class. Stays IIa across all Luscii programs we'd surface.

LusciiProgramData.title: LusciiProgramData
LusciiProgramData.description:
Full Luscii program payload, stored as JSONB in `luscii_program.data`.

Stub-mode rows are seeded from this shape; future live-mode rows are
upserted with the same shape. The orchestrator consumes it via the
`resolve_block` adapter method and regenerated TypeScript types.

LusciiProgramSummary.title: LusciiProgramSummary
LusciiProgramSummary.description: Lightweight program row for the inspector picker.

LusciiProtocol.title: LusciiProtocol
LusciiProtocol.description: A Luscii protocol — variant of a program with its own cadence.

LusciiUnknownPoint.title: LusciiUnknownPoint
LusciiUnknownPoint.description: Fallback point for values the classifier cannot categorise.

MobileHealthResponse.title: MobileHealthResponse
MobileHealthResponse.description: Stable shape for the mobile-app liveness probe.

ParticipantCreate.title: ParticipantCreate
ParticipantCreate.description:
`POST /care-teams/{id}/participants` payload.

Opens a new participant row. The service enforces the partial unique
constraint (`uq_care_team_participants_open_membership`) by checking
for an existing open row before insert. `acting_as_practitioner_role_id`
is optional (NULL permitted per `practitioner-role-split`).

ParticipantRoleChange.title: ParticipantRoleChange
ParticipantRoleChange.description:
`PATCH /care-teams/{id}/participants/{user_id}` payload.

Role changes are append-only: the service closes the current open
row (sets `period_end`, `unassigned_by`) and inserts a new open row
with the new role in the same transaction.

PathwayActorRef.title: PathwayActorRef
PathwayActorRef.description: Minimal user reference embedded in version summaries.

PathwayBare.title: PathwayBare
PathwayBare.description:
Identity fields only — no version-scoped children. Returned as the
`pathway` arm of `PathwayWithVersionResponse`.

lane_id.title: Lane Id
lane_id.description: Optional. When omitted the backend materializes the block type's default lane (catalogue.allowed_lane_kind_codes[0]).

PathwayBlockIn.title: PathwayBlockIn
PathwayBlockIn.description:
Typed-only block payload (chain slot #2 §6).

The slot-#1 legacy `(type, config)` dual shape is retired; the
wire now carries the typed `BaseBlock` subclass payload under
`config` directly. `kind` is the discriminator (replaces the
slot-#1 `type` column) — `_LEGACY_TYPE_ALIASES` in the resolver
still maps the dotted external-program code (`luscii.program`)
for storage parity.

semantics.title: Semantics
semantics.description: Runtime dispatch key. Multiple types may share semantics in the future (e.g. appointment subtypes) without forcing per-type branching.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Lucide icon name. Resolved client-side via a single lookup.

allowed_lane_kind_codes.title: Allowed Lane Kind Codes
allowed_lane_kind_codes.description: Lane-kind codes this block type may be placed on. The first entry is the default placement when no explicit lane context exists.

ui_schema.title: Ui Schema
ui_schema.description: Widget hints, field order, and labels for schema-driven inspector rendering. Consumed by the orchestrator's SchemaForm engine.

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance of this catalogue entry. Native blocks live in our own code-side `BLOCK_TYPES` registry; external blocks are contributed by per-vendor catalogue extensions (Luscii first). The frontend palette groups by `source` then by `provider`.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Vendor identifier for external blocks (e.g. `luscii`). Null for native blocks. Combined with `kind`, identifies which per-provider React component renders the block on canvas / in the inspector.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Vendor-specific block kind for external blocks (e.g. `program`). Null for native blocks.

nested_render.title: Nested Render
nested_render.description: UI hint for blocks whose body renders nested content (today: `pathway_link`). `inline_preview` expands a read-only summary of the linked content inside the parent canvas; `collapsed_card` renders as a single card requiring drill-down to view content. Null for blocks without nested content.

PathwayChildSummary.title: PathwayChildSummary
PathwayChildSummary.description:
Minimal summary returned by `GET /pathways/{id}/summary` — drives the
read-only child preview rendered inside a parent pathway's nested-pathway
inspector. `lane_count` / `block_count` come from the pathway's preferred
version (latest published if it exists; otherwise the concept version)
so the inspector reflects what a parent would actually link to.

PathwayDefinitionReplace.title: PathwayDefinitionReplace
PathwayDefinitionReplace.description:
Autosave body for `PUT /pathways/{id}` — applied to the current concept
version's children. Pathway identity fields (`name`/`clinical_goal`/
`patient_goal`) live on the pathway row and are mutable regardless of
version status.

lane_kind_code.title: Lane Kind Code
lane_kind_code.description: System lane-kind code (resolves to pathway_lane_kind.id server-side)

PathwayParentReference.title: PathwayParentReference
PathwayParentReference.description:
Minimal identifier returned by `GET /pathways/{id}/parent-references`.
Drives the delete-confirmation modal: when this list is non-empty the
target pathway is used as a sub-pathway by another pathway and may not
be deleted until those references are removed.

clinically_approved.title: Clinically Approved
clinically_approved.description: Must be true. The frontend gates this behind an explicit checkbox.

PathwayPublishRequest.title: PathwayPublishRequest
PathwayPublishRequest.description:
Body for `POST /pathways/{id}/publish` — promotes the current concept.
`clinically_approved` is `Literal[True]`: anything else is a 422 from the
framework rather than a custom validator (keeps the error payload JSON-
serialisable without bespoke handling).

PathwaySummary.title: PathwaySummary
PathwaySummary.description:
Overview row for `GET /pathways`. Rollups derived per `pathway-version`
Requirement 11 — backend joins `pathway_version` + `pathway_block`, never
reads denormalised columns on `pathway`.

PathwayVersionDefinition.title: PathwayVersionDefinition
PathwayVersionDefinition.description:
Snapshot of one pathway version — meta + children. Returned by version
detail endpoints and embedded as `version` in `PathwayWithVersionResponse`.

PathwayWithVersionResponse.title: PathwayWithVersionResponse
PathwayWithVersionResponse.description:
Resolved-version envelope for `GET /pathways/{id}` and `POST /pathways`.

`version` is the current concept if one exists, else the latest published
(per `pathway-version` spec Requirement 9).

PatientCreate.title: PatientCreate
PatientCreate.description:
`POST /patients` payload.

`identifiers` is part of the create payload so a patient can be born
with an INSZ in a single transaction. Updating identifiers later goes
through a dedicated endpoint (out of scope for `patients-base`); the
PATCH route rejects the field outright (see `PatientUpdate`).

PatientIdentifierCreate.title: PatientIdentifierCreate
PatientIdentifierCreate.description:
Identifier payload for `POST /patients`.

`system` is a free-text URI — we keep the column open so unknown
namespaces (e.g. local lab numbers) pass through. The Mod-97 check
only runs when the system is the Belgian INSZ namespace.

PatientInlineSummary.title: PatientInlineSummary
PatientInlineSummary.description:
Thin patient projection used as a JOIN-resolved inline summary.

Lives in the patient domain so any caller that needs a "patient
headline" projection (today: `tasks-base` aggregator; tomorrow:
notification feeds, alerts, anywhere a patient name + INSZ + org is
needed without a full `PatientRead`) shares one shape.

`insz` is the value of the patient's INSZ identifier row from
`patient_identifiers`, NULL when missing. Resolved by the caller via
JOIN at projection time — the model itself does not load it.

PatientUpdate.title: PatientUpdate
PatientUpdate.description:
`PATCH /patients/{id}` payload — demographics only.

`model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")` is what produces the 422
when a client sends `identifiers` here: FastAPI translates Pydantic's
`extra_forbidden` error into a 422 response automatically.

PractitionerRoleUpdate.title: PractitionerRoleUpdate
PractitionerRoleUpdate.description:
PATCH payload for an open role.

`period_end` is intentionally NOT settable here — closing a role goes
through `DELETE /practitioner-roles/{id}` so the close-side invariants
(drop primary, stamp `period_end=now`) run in one place. Reopening a
closed role is not supported; open a fresh row instead.

PractitionerSummary.title: PractitionerSummary
PractitionerSummary.description:
Denormalised practitioner identity for list views.

Populated by serialising a `Practitioner` ORM row whose `user`
relationship is loaded (selectinload). The `display_name` field is
pulled from the linked `User`; the rest are direct columns.

PredicateKind.title: PredicateKind
PredicateKind.description:
Closed enum of supported input-logic predicates (D3).

No expression language. Adding a new predicate is a typed code
change here + a new `Args` model + an evaluator branch.

RoleSelectionRequiredResponse.title: RoleSelectionRequiredResponse
RoleSelectionRequiredResponse.description:
Login succeeded but the human holds several roles on this surface
(REQ-NON-3). The session cookie is set and live; protected routes answer
409 until `POST /auth/session/role` binds one of `available_roles`.

ShieldingAudience.title: ShieldingAudience
ShieldingAudience.description:
Limited-sight audiences a category can be released to.

Subjects holding `view_shielded` (care team, org chain, break-glass)
never pass through the policy service — full sight by construction.

ShieldingRuleUpsert.title: ShieldingRuleUpsert
ShieldingRuleUpsert.description:
Upsert keyed by (pathway_id, item_category, audience);
`pathway_id = null` targets the global rule.

SpecialismIdsUpdate.title: SpecialismIdsUpdate
SpecialismIdsUpdate.description: Replace-set semantics: the full desired link set, not a diff.

TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description:
Unified envelope returned by `GET /tasks` and `GET /tasks/{source}/{source_id}`.

Sortable by `due_at` (which v1 always maps to `appointment.starts_at`).
`priority` is reserved for future sources; v1 appointment source
always emits `null`.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
Role-discriminated admin-create payload.

- `admin` branch: requires `display_name`; rejects clinical fields.
- `caregiver` branch: requires `given_name` + `family_name`; rejects
  `display_name` (the backend derives `user.display_name` from given+family).
  `qualification` is optional.

The model_validator enforces mutual exclusion so a mixed payload is a 422,
not a silent half-fill.

ValueEqualsArgs.title: ValueEqualsArgs
ValueEqualsArgs.description: A produced field equals `expected`. Pure value compare, no coercion.

ValueGtArgs.title: ValueGtArgs
ValueGtArgs.description: A produced numeric field is strictly greater than `threshold`.

WaitAfterArgs.title: WaitAfterArgs
WaitAfterArgs.description: Anchored wait: marker reached + ISO 8601 offset, direction-signed.

WaitAfterPolicy.title: WaitAfterPolicy
WaitAfterPolicy.description:
Block fires after an ISO 8601 offset from its eligibility moment.

`PT0S` means "fire as soon as eligible" — used as the default
backfill for rows that carry no authored timing.
